reason: I'm not putting a proxy from a vendor with no customers and no SOC 2 into our order path. It would never get through our own vendor due diligence, free or not. And the examiner asked how we use AI. I can answer that with a policy and an inventory, not with a startup's identity registry.
objection: The passports come from a registry the vendor's own founder started, so the thing vouching for the agents is the vendor. If that company folds or gets it wrong, it's my name on the exam response, and 'the startup said the agent was fine' won't satisfy anyone.
would_change_my_mind: An examiner asking us specifically how we control customers' AI agents trading, at a time when the vendor has a finished SOC 2 Type II and a peer broker running it in production.
